statement: Under the same short-prime-interval hypothesis and Theorem 4.1 used by van Doorn--Tang, their proof yields n_k>exp(c(log k)^2/log log k) for every fixed c<min((1-theta)/6,1/12); in particular c=1/16 is valid uniformly for theta in (2/5,3/5).
dependency_gaps: No independent natural-language reconstruction by a different reviewer has yet been completed.
The external Konyagin theorem and short-prime-interval theorem are reused exactly as in arXiv:2606.19863 rather than re-proved here.
A web search found no public version of the constant refinement, so publication priority remains uncertain.
The upper-bound/true-order half of Erdős #451 is untouched by this lemma.
